description: Signed ALLOW token emitted by context-fabric (Layer 2). A DENY result is returned by the evaluator/generator API as an object with decision=DENY, empty capabilities and NO signature field; a DENY is never a valid token under this schema's verification rules (see verify in INTERFACE.md).

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the canonical token body (token without this field, JSON sorted keys, separators ',' and ':'). Dev scheme only — see INTERFACE.md.
